msg: Hi! We're on our honeymoon from Toronto, staying at a hotel in Barú. Neither of us has ever dived. We'd love something special and romantic underwater. What do you suggest and how much? Can we pay in Canadian dollars?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Happy honeymoon! For a first underwater experience together, I’d recommend our **Dive Mini Course**: it includes pre-activity theory, pool practice, and one open-water dive with an instructor—no experience or certification needed. The online booking includes a 10% discount.

You’d pay in **US dollars**, not Canadian dollars. International guests pay by card on the website. Your hotel in Barú isn’t listed as a pickup point, so I can’t confirm transport from there; the Cartagena departure meets at Muelle de la Bodeguita.

[Book the Dive Mini Course](https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en)

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you like to go with the mini-course, or would you prefer a snorkeling option?

msg: We'll both do the mini course! What time do we need to be at the dock and is lunch included? Is there a private boat option for honeymooners?
reply:
For the mini-course, please be at **Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.** Lunch is included, and you’ll return to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (estimated arrival around 4:15 p.m.).

It also includes:
• National Park entrance fee
• Mandatory dive insurance
• Boat transport Cartagena-Islands-Cartagena
• Pool training + 1 ocean dive with a PADI instructor
• Diving equipment
• Eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL

Happy to help! 🌊 For private groups or corporate events we coordinate everything custom (available instructor, date, activities) — there's no fixed price, it depends on group size and date. I'll connect you with an advisor from the team to put together a quote.
